aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 571 - Refresh Time: 0:00:01 - Ability Timer(s): 0. This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Abyssal Nightmare. Requirements: level 50, Unholy Steed at level 1.

aas.name: Harm Touch
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 6000 - Refresh Time: 0:20:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Harm Touch II, when activated, grips a non-player target with agony, instantly dealing up to 751 damage based on your current level. Ranks 9 and 10 add a Damage Over Time effect to the target. Requirements: Level 1/6/11/16/21/26/31/36/41/46.

aas.name: Leech Touch
aas.description: This passive ability augments the Harm Touch ability by giving it a lifetap effect. Requirements: Level 1.

aas.name: Soul Abrasion
aas.description: This passive ability increases the base damage of lifetaps triggered by Vampiric Embrace and Scream of Death by 50/100/200%. Requirements: level 15.

aas.name: Unbound Drain
aas.description: Gives a passive 2/4/6% increase in damage for lifetap spells. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

aas.name: Unholy Steed
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 85 - Refresh Time: 0:00:01 - Ability Timer(s): 0. This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Unholy Steed. Requirements: level 20.

aas.name: Cannibalization
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 47 - Refresh Time: 0:03:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Cannibalization I, when activated, consumes 1924 health to restore 1066 mana. Requirements: level 40, Mental Clarity at level 3.

aas.name: Unbound Cascade
aas.description: This passive ability increases the damage dealt by your critical damage over time spells by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 12/30/50.

aas.name: Area Taunt
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 110 - Refresh Time: 0:05:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Area Taunt I, when activated, taunts all creatures within a 40 foot radius, placing you 100 points of hate higher than your opponents' previously most hated target. Requirements: level 25.

aas.name: Heroic Leap
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 2016 - Refresh Time: 0:00:30 - Ability Timer(s): 9. Heroic Leap I, when activated, causes you to leap approximately 10 feet in front of your target, attracting the attention of up to 8 opponents within a 40 foot radius of your target, increasing their hatred for you by 1250 points. Requirements: level 12.

aas.name: Innate Fighters Tenacity
aas.description: Grants the Warrior the ability to go into a frezy at low health, increasing critical strike chance, and also permanetly mitigate 5% of all incoming melee damage. Below 35% health, the warrior goes into a berserker frenzy, gaining increased chance to hit, and turns their critical attacks into criplling blows, which deal increased damage, and can stun the target. The warrior will remain in this state until their health reaches 45%. Requirements: level 1.

aas.name: Unbound Wrath
aas.description: This passive ability increases your melee critical hit damage by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 12.

aas.name: War Cry
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 111 - Refresh Time: 0:36:00 - Ability Timer(s): 3. War Cry I, when activated, grants all group members within a 100 foot radius immunity to fear spells for 10 seconds. Requirements: level 25, Fear Resistance at level 3.

aas.name: Warrior's Endurance

aas.name: Improved Familiar
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 52 - Refresh Time: 0:01:00 - Ability Timer(s): 8. Improved Familiar I, which when activated, triggers Summon Improved Familiar I, the physical manifestation of your familiar, increases the damage dealt by your critical direct damage spells by 3%, the casting levels of your spells by 9, your cold, disease, fire, magic, and poison resistances by 25 points, your mana regeneration by 6 points, your maximum mana by 200 points, and allows you to see invisible creatures. Requirements: level 45.

aas.name: Mana Burn
aas.description: Ability Activation ID: 565 - Refresh Time: 1:12:00 - Ability Timer(s): 7. Mana Burn I, when activated, consumes up to 3000 mana to deal 4x of the consumed mana as direct damage and prevents additional Mana Burn spells from landing on that target for 0:01:00. Requirements: level 45, Mental Clarity at level 3.

aas.name: Quick Evacuation

aas.name: Strong Root
